_metadata.method: Per-organ score quality from bootstrap-of-mean CI on the borough's last 30 days of gold time-series for bootstrappable organs (air, transit, immune). Borough-specific static signals (green-space variants, modelled air) are flagged green with a cadence note. London-wide signals (sentiment) are flagged amber because they are not borough-specific. Composite_score flag is derived from the input organ flags (red if 2+ red, amber if 1 red OR 2+ amber, else green); its bootstrap CI is nulled when overridden to avoid contradicting the input-quality flag.

air_score.note: No recent reading — local sensor coverage gap.

air_quality_modelled_score.note: LAEI 2022 atmospheric model — precise for the year modelled; annual update.

sentiment_score.note: London-wide news signal — same value applied to every borough. Reliable for London, not borough-specific.

green_space_score.note: GLA 2024 green-cover measurement — precise; updated yearly because physical coverage doesn't change daily.

composite_score.flag_basis: derived from input organs: 1 red, 0 amber, 2 green of 3 bootstrappable inputs
